europe_now.title: Ceuta migrant surge triggers EU emergency talks
europe_now.summary: Ceuta experienced a migrant surge that prompted the EU to hold two days of emergency talks. Spanish authorities reported that most of those who crossed the border have since departed, according to official statements.

europe_now.title: Greece wildfires intensify amid strong winds
europe_now.summary: Strong winds drove wildfires across Greece, increasing the fire toll and prompting helicopter operations. Authorities reported that blazes spread amid the winds, leading to a collision of two firefighting helicopters near Athens.

europe_now.summary: Ukraine reports that a major Russian oil refinery and an airfield were struck, resulting in eight deaths reported by Moscow. The incident underscores the ongoing conflict's impact on critical infrastructure.

europe_now.title: European Wildfire Crisis
europe_now.summary: Wildfires across Europe, including a megafire in Gironde and extensive blazes in Greece, have prompted large firefighting deployments. The incidents have caused casualties and significant property damage.
